_about: أصول السنة للحميدي — a short creed treatise in 8 numbered paragraphs; al-Humaydi states beliefs, quotes Sufyan and others, and refutes opposing views. The editor added the bracketed headings and wrote the footnotes.
_heading_by_note: the editor says in his introduction that he gave each paragraph a number and a heading between brackets

types.label: مسألة اعتقاد
types.description: a point of belief the text affirms (faith, the Qur'an, God's attributes, the companions, the vision of God)

types.label: رد على مخالف
types.description: a view the text rejects, and who holds it when the text names them
types.example: من قال القرآن مخلوق فهو مبتدع

types.label: منهج
types.description: how belief is to be taken and held: following the texts, not interpreting the attributes, what is not debated
types.example: لا نزيد فيه ولا نفسره، نقف على ما وقف عليه القرآن والسنة

types.label: معنى كلمة أو مصطلح
types.description: the meaning of a word or term, as the editor's footnote explains it (said_by editor)
